# Why do my payroll hours import wrong or get rejected?

> Free payroll hours CSV checker: finds 8:30 mixed with 8.5, text like 8h, Excel date serials, mixed date formats, duplicate person-days, hours over 24, Start/End times that disagree with the hours typed and unquoted commas in names, with line numbers, and applies formatting-only safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
